serverInfo.name: FoldCopilot
serverInfo.description: Confidence-aware interpretation copilot for protein structure predictions. 6 backends (Boltz-2, OpenFold3, Chai-1, Protenix-v2, AF3, AQAffinity), 34 MCP tools spanning confidence assessment, structural search, prediction, ensemble comparison, annotations, therapeutic verticals, design validation, education, and benchmarking.
serverInfo.author: Adarsh

tools.name: lookup_structure
tools.description: Look up AlphaFold Database prediction metadata for a UniProt accession.

tools.name: get_plddt_scores
tools.description: Fetch per-residue pLDDT confidence scores from AFDB.

tools.name: get_pae_summary
tools.description: Summarize the Predicted Aligned Error matrix for a protein.

tools.name: assess_confidence
tools.description: Generate a structured ConfidenceReport with pLDDT bucketing, PAE summary, IDR cross-check vs DisProt/MobiDB, and hallucination warnings.

tools.name: foldseek_search
tools.description: Search for structurally similar proteins using Foldseek webserver API.

tools.name: foldseek_search_uniprot
tools.description: Search Foldseek using a UniProt accession instead of raw PDB.

tools.name: find_confident_homologs
tools.description: Find structural homologs filtered by confidence thresholds.

tools.name: predict_structure
tools.description: Predict protein structure using Boltz-2, OpenFold3, Chai-1, Protenix-v2, AF3, or AQAffinity.

tools.name: check_backend_status
tools.description: Check if a prediction backend is installed and GPU-ready.

tools.name: list_prediction_backends
tools.description: List all 6 supported prediction backends with license and capability info.

tools.name: compare_predictions
tools.description: Compare two predicted structures for per-residue agreement and disagreement.

tools.name: compare_prediction_files
tools.description: Compare two PDB files from different prediction backends.

tools.name: get_missense_landscape
tools.description: Get AlphaMissense pathogenicity landscape for a protein.

tools.name: get_cofactors
tools.description: Get AlphaFill cofactor transplantation data for a protein.

tools.name: get_full_annotation
tools.description: Get combined AlphaMissense + AlphaFill + TMalphaFold annotation.

tools.name: analyze_antibody
tools.description: Antibody-specific structural analysis with CDR confidence and SAbDab cross-reference.

tools.name: analyze_kinase
tools.description: Kinase-specific analysis with DFG motif, activation loop, and KLIFS cross-reference.

tools.name: analyze_gpcr
tools.description: GPCR-specific analysis with TM helix confidence and membrane orientation.

tools.name: design_antibody
tools.description: Antibody design guidance using Protenix-v2 VHH-Fc capabilities.

tools.name: explain_score
tools.description: Plain-language explanation of a pLDDT confidence score.

tools.name: explain_pae_score
tools.description: Plain-language explanation of a PAE value.

tools.name: explain_hallucination
tools.description: Explain what a structural hallucination means in context.

tools.name: explain_report
tools.description: Generate plain-language summary of a full ConfidenceReport.

tools.name: list_benchmarks
tools.description: List available benchmark datasets (CASP16, DisProt, PSBench).

tools.name: benchmark_prediction
tools.description: Evaluate a single prediction against reference structure.

tools.name: benchmark_batch
tools.description: Run batch benchmarks across multiple targets.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate a benchmark results report.

tools.name: get_membrane_context
tools.description: Get TMalphaFold membrane topology and OPM orientation.

tools.name: export_notebook
tools.description: Export confidence analysis as Jupyter notebook.

tools.name: export_benchmark_notebook
tools.description: Export benchmark results as Jupyter notebook.

tools.name: check_fold_drift
tools.description: Scan prediction manifests for backend version drift.

tools.name: check_prediction_drift
tools.description: Check if a single prediction would differ with current backend version.

tools.name: validate_design
tools.description: Validate protein design output from BindCraft, RFdiffusion3, or ProteinMPNN.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Server health check with version, tool count, backend status, and timestamp.
